spanish: En lugar que degollarán el holocausto degollarán la culpa, y su sangre echará sobre el altar alrededor.

findings.issue: הָאָשָׁם is the definite singular object of slaughter and the masculine possessor of the blood; «la culpa» names abstract guilt and omits the offering.

notes: Place, both 3mp slaughter verbs, 3ms throw, blood, altar, and around match the tokens.
